stories.title: Thinking Machines 的 Inkling 2 Small 在基准测试中爆出 316 次 F 脏话 / Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs

sources.title: Thinking Machines 的 Inkling 2 Small 在基准测试中爆出 316 次 F 脏话 / Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs
sources.title_zh: Thinking Machines 的 Inkling 2 Small 在基准测试中爆出 316 次 F 脏话
sources.title_en: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs
sources.title_original: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs
sources.summary:
Thinking Machines' AI model Inkling 2 Small swears during its internal reasoning, 316 times across 2,655 benchmark runs, according to an analysis by Vals AI. The profanity typically shows up late in long runs that fail anyway. But it doesn't work as a warning signal: 96 percent of failed runs contained no cursing at all.
Thinking Machines' AI model Inkling 2 Small swears during its internal reasoning, 316 times across 2,655 benchmark runs, according to an analysis by Vals AI. The profanity typic
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Vals AI分析发现Thinking Machines的Inkling 2 Small在2,655次benchmark运行中内部推理爆粗316次，241次集中于两次失控运行，且96%的失败运行毫无脏话，说明爆粗不能当失败预警信号。

en.reason: Vals AI found Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small swore 316 times across 2,655 benchmark runs, mostly late in long runs that failed anyway, while 96% of failures contained no profanity, undermining cursing as a warning signal.

sources.title_en: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds
sources.title_original: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds
sources.summary:
AI models can often spot problematic behavior by other AI agents in logs, according to a study by Anthropic researcher Andy Hall. GPT-5 found about 98 percent of reward-hacking cases, but the more exhaustively the search is tuned, the more false alarms pile up. That's not yet enough for reliable safety checks.

en.reason: Anthropic researcher Andy Hall's replication of METR research found GPT-5 caught nearly 98% of reward-hacking cases at a 5% false-alarm rate, but tightening the search produced more false positives, leaving AI auditors short of reliable safety checks.

stories.title: 开源与闭源 AI 模型在网络能力上的差距正不断缩小 / The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking

sources.title: 开源与闭源 AI 模型在网络能力上的差距正不断缩小 / The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking
sources.title_zh: 开源与闭源 AI 模型在网络能力上的差距正不断缩小
sources.title_en: The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking
sources.title_original: The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking
sources.summary:
In the Vals AI benchmark, OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol Daybreak hits 80.8 percent of attack objectives in simulated corporate networks. Worse, the open-weight model DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reaches 72.8 percent at a tenth of the cost. Because open models can no longer be restricted, analysts say the window for defenders is shrinking fast.
In the Vals AI benchmark, OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol Daybreak hits 80.8 percent of attack objectives in simulated corporate networks. Worse, the open-weight model DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Vals AI基准中，OpenAI的GPT-6 Sol Daybreak在模拟企业网络达成80.8%攻击目标，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash以约十分之一成本达72.8%，英国AISI称开放与闭源模型网络能力差距缩至四到七个月。

en.reason: Vals AI benchmark results show OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol Daybreak hitting 80.8% of attack objectives and open-weight DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reaching 72.8% at roughly one-tenth the cost, while UK AISI estimates a four-to-seven-month capability gap.

stories.title: 一些中国 AI 模型里的官方宣传内容只是“薄薄一层”，微调就能将其剥离 / State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away

sources.title: 一些中国 AI 模型里的官方宣传内容只是“薄薄一层”，微调就能将其剥离 / State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
sources.title_zh: 一些中国 AI 模型里的官方宣传内容只是“薄薄一层”，微调就能将其剥离
sources.title_en: State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
sources.title_original: State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
sources.summary:
Nous Research retrained Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to produce Arete-27B, largely stripping out its pro-Chinese bias. The propaganda rate dropped from 22 percent to less than one percent, while general capabilities remained intact in tests. The method relied on 53 million tokens of supervised fine-tuning. The political bias is "applied late, it is applied thin," the team writes.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google Research的AI仅凭智能手表脉搏与运动传感器筛查高血压，在196人研究中检出率65.8%，高于传统诊室测量的55.3%，该功能已进入Google Health app但仍不能替代正式诊断。

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 教程介绍如何在 NVIDIA TensorRT LLM VisualGen 中配置 FLUX 3 Image Klein，利用融合内核、多 GPU 并行与 FP8/NVFP4 等优化，在单张 B200 的 2048×2048 测试中较未编译 BF16 实现最高 3.46 倍 T2I 和 4.45 倍 I2I 加速。

sources.summary: GPT Image 2.6正式上线，新增了透明底GIF、SVG矢量图能力，生成速度提升约50%，API还提供多档思考强度可调。小歪做了多场景的实测，电商图、漫画分镜、家装方案都能落地，噪点问题小幅改善，但依然存在手指畸形、中文信息图文字错乱、多次迭代修改后质感下滑、塑料感变强等短板。快来看看真实效果如何！
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT Image 2.6，文章对照 2.5 噪点明显的样图，实测新版是否改善，并称它已进入 Codex，覆盖全部订阅档位和桌面端、移动端、网页端。

en.title: GPT Image 2.6 is here with one-sentence GIF generation — I'm more interested in whether it's fixed the noise issue.
en.summary: GPT Image 2.6 is officially live, adding transparent-background GIF and SVG vector graphics support, boosting generation speed by roughly 50%, and offering adjustable thinking levels through the API. Xiaowei ran real-world tests across multiple scenarios — e-commerce product shots, comic storyboards, and home interior layouts all proved workable, and noise issues improved slightly. But shortcomings remain: deformed fingers, garbled text in Chinese infographics, degrading quality after repeated iterative edits, and an increasingly plastic look. Check out how it actually performs.
en.reason: OpenAI's GPT Image 2.6 adds transparent-background GIF and SVG output, roughly 50% faster generation and adjustable reasoning strength in the API, and a hands-on test across e-commerce, manga storyboards and home decor finds noise modestly improved but finger distortion, garbled Chinese text in infographics and plastic-looking quality after repeated edits still unresolved.

stories.title: 多 Agent 上下文共享怎么做？关键不是同步聊天记录

sources.title: 多 Agent 上下文共享怎么做？关键不是同步聊天记录
sources.title_zh: 多 Agent 上下文共享怎么做？关键不是同步聊天记录
sources.title_original: 多 Agent 上下文共享怎么做？关键不是同步聊天记录
sources.summary: 多个 Agent 一起干活，最容易卡在交接：模型额度用完、任务换人，新接手的 Agent 要么被整段聊天记录淹没，要么又得从头摸索。这篇文章很适合已经开始多模型协作、却总在切换时丢进度的人。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者用Hermes调度，让Claude Code与Codex并行执行，又因换模型接力时上下文难接而做agentshare，主张共享任务状态而非完整聊天记录。

en.title: How should multiple Agents share context? The key isn't syncing chat logs
en.summary: When multiple Agents work together, the handoff is where things break down: a model runs out of quota, the task changes hands, and the incoming Agent either drowns in the full chat history or has to feel its way from scratch. This article is for anyone already running multi-model collaboration but keeps losing progress every time they switch.
en.reason: After Hermes-scheduled Claude Code and Codex runs made model handoffs lose context, the author built agentshare to share task state rather than full chat logs, explaining a multi-agent collaboration pattern for teams already switching models.

stories.title: 贾栾：企业如何搭建一套自己的 AI 智能体工作台？

sources.title: 贾栾：企业如何搭建一套自己的 AI 智能体工作台？
sources.title_zh: 贾栾：企业如何搭建一套自己的 AI 智能体工作台？
sources.title_original: 贾栾：企业如何搭建一套自己的 AI 智能体工作台？
sources.summary: 企业把 AI 接进来，很多团队还是停留在单纯地“给员工装个工具”：一碰权限、数据、业务系统和万人并发，方案就乱了。作者这篇文章完整梳理了企业如何搭建一套自己的 AI 智能体工作台，适合正在做内部落地、又担心安全和规模的人。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章讨论上万名员工规模的企业搭建类似WorkBuddy的AI工作台，指出落地远不只是安装OpenClaw，还要让员工创建智能体、分享给同事并操作内部业务系统。

en.title: Jia Luan: How can enterprises build their own AI agent workbench?
en.summary: When enterprises bring AI in, many teams are still stuck at simply handing employees a tool: the moment permissions, data, business systems, and concurrency at the scale of tens of thousands of users come into play, the plan falls apart. This article lays out how companies can build their own AI agent workbench—aimed at those driving internal rollouts who are also worried about security and scale.
en.reason: Building an AI agent workbench for tens of thousands of employees goes beyond installing OpenClaw, covering how staff create agents, share them with colleagues, and operate internal business systems.

en.title: After 5.2 million words and 500,000 judgments, I built what may be the most hardcore "de-AI-flavor" Skill on the internet.
en.summary: The author analyzed 5.2 million words and 500,000 semantic judgments to break AI writing habits down into more than 100 metrics. If you regularly use AI to write, this piece can save you a lot of time you'd otherwise lose to frustrating rewrites.
en.reason: Drawing on 1,169 articles, 5.2 million Chinese characters and 507,000 sentence-by-sentence semantic judgments, the author breaks “AI flavor” into more than 100 indicators and builds a quantifiable Skill for evaluating and reducing AI-like writing.

en.title: Components of Agent Memory
en.reason: Claude uses dreaming to review logs during idle time and correct mistakes, drawing on Letta and UC Berkeley's sleep-time compute to distinguish agent memory from in-context learning and compaction.

en.title: GPT Image 2.6 released: what's changed in speed, pricing, and SVG output
en.summary:
GPT Image 2.6 Released: What Changed in Speed, Pricing, and SVG Output

GPT Image 2.6 has officially launched. OpenAI's API changelog lists the release date as November 4, 2026, while the announcement from the official developer account was posted on the morning of November 5, Beijing time.
en.reason: GPT Image 2.6, released 4 November 2026 per OpenAI's API changelog, claims 50% faster generation—Flare at low quality in about 6 seconds—and adds SVG, animated GIF output and complexity control at the same token price as 2.5.

en.title: 10,000-word deep dive: Deconstructing the DeepSeek Super-agent × enterprise knowledge base architecture and putting it into practice
en.summary:
A 10,000-word deep dive: Deconstructing the DeepSeek Super-agent × enterprise knowledge base architecture, and how to put it into practice

In recent years we've focused on building AI products, and we've used this account to share high-value open-source AI projects. Over the past two years we've watched LLM applications move from "simple Q&A" to "Agent execution," and seen enterprise knowledge bases evolve from "pure retrieval RAG" to structured knowledge capture. But when these two threads meet in real business settings, a new dilemma quickly surfaces: most Agents are still "conversational temps"—every time they spin up, they have to be briefed on context again, re-retrieve knowledge, and push tasks forward single-threaded; meanwhile knowledge bases remain "passive archives"—they only produce answers when someone asks, and never push knowledge into business workflows on their own.
en.reason: DeepSeek Harness’s Super-agent and enterprise knowledge-base architecture are broken down for implementation, with a 300-message, 20-request benchmark showing p95 15.7 minutes versus 29.5 minutes.

Title: 实测 agent-desktop：AI 控制桌面不截图、不占鼠标键盘，连点 55 次计算器 0 失误
Published Time: 2026-11-06T11:26:33+00:00
以前让 AI 操作电脑上的软件，常规做法都是屏幕截图塞给模型看、猜像素坐标再用鼠标点过去：既费 token，干活时还会直接抢占你的鼠标和键盘。
Vercel Labs 昨天（11 月 5 日）给开源工具 agent-desktop 发布了 1.2.0 版本，加入了 MCP 支持。它的原理是直接读取操作系统的无障碍树，给界面的每个控件编号，让 AI 依据编号精准触发；操作默认在后台执行，全程不需要截图，也不会抢占你的鼠标键盘。
我一年光 AI 订阅就要花费 1.7 万元，月底对账非常繁琐，正好拿它做测试：将其接入 WorkBuddy，让它控制系统计算器把 15 笔账单逐笔加总、填入记事本，实测全程 0 截图，55 次按键没有一次点错。
第 1 步：打开客户端，点击左侧侧边栏的「新建任务」，进入空白对话窗口。
第 2 步：完全不需要自己手动折腾底层环境，直接在对话框中发送安装需求：
帮我在电脑
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 实测 Vercel Labs 的 agent-desktop 1.2.0 靠无障碍树编号后台操作，连点计算器 55 次、82.8 秒加总 15 笔账单，0 失误且不占鼠标键盘，但单步约 1.5 秒、补字保存花 3 分 49 秒。

en.title: Hands-on with agent-desktop: AI controls the desktop without screenshots or taking over the mouse and keyboard—55 consecutive Calculator clicks with zero errors
en.summary:
**Hands-on with agent-desktop: the AI controls your desktop with no screenshots and no hijacking of mouse or keyboard — 55 straight clicks in Calculator, zero errors**

The usual way to get an AI to drive desktop software has been to stuff screenshots into the model, have it guess pixel coordinates, and click away with the mouse: it burns tokens, and it takes over your mouse and keyboard while it works.

Yesterday (Nov 5), Vercel Labs released version 1.2.0 of its open-source tool agent-desktop, adding MCP support. It works by reading the operating system's accessibility tree directly and assigning a number to every control on screen, so the AI can trigger the right one by its number; actions run in the background by default, with no screenshots at any point and no seizing of your mouse and keyboard.

I spend 17,000 yuan a year on AI subscriptions alone, and reconciling the books at month's end is a real chore, so it made a good test case: I hooked it up to WorkBuddy and had it drive the system Calculator to total 15 bills one by one and type the results into Notepad. Zero screenshots throughout, and not a single misclick across 55 keystrokes.

Step 1: Open the client, click "New Task" in the left sidebar, and you land in a blank chat window.

Step 2: There's no need to wrestle with the underlying environment yourself — just send the install request in the chat box: Help me on my computer
en.reason: Vercel Labs' agent-desktop 1.2.0 uses accessibility-tree control numbering to run in the background, summing 15 bills with 55 error-free calculator clicks in 82.8 seconds without screenshots or grabbing mouse and keyboard.

选型选得好只是锦上添花，最终还是要先把用户最真实的需求解决好。

选型选得好只是锦上添花，最终还是要先把用户最真实的需求解决好。
发现不少小伙伴很好奇我是怎么用 Mac 来开发 Windows 软件的，以及 Windows 软件现在一般用什么技术栈来实现，刚好我这段时间也在做类似的事情，来和大伙随便聊聊关于多端技术选择的思考。
做过前端客户端的小伙伴应该都知道，这些年端的开发一般是这三条路。
第一种最简单方便的是，直接写 Web 代码，塞到浏览器就能跑，包括早年的 PhoneGap、Cordova 就是把网页塞进一个原生壳里，然后提供一些 bridge 的能力让 JS 可以调用到一些原生的能力，比如唤起手机摄像头这类的 Web 不好做的事情。
第二种是跨端开发，也就是早年大家常听到的一码多端。当时移动端有 React Native、Weex 这一类技术，主要是为了解决 Web 性能差的问题，一份代码同时打包 iOS 和 Android。国内大厂当时重度用跨端还有一个非常大的原因，就是动态化和热更新，讲得土一点就是可以绕过商店
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者复盘AI时代客户端选型，并以Mole为例披露Windows版用C#+WinUI 3跑.NET 10、十几万行Swift代码可复用不足20%，11种语言靠脚本同步。

en.title: Client Development You Didn't Know About: Stack Choices, Native, and Leverage in the AI Era
en.summary:
Picking the right stack is just the icing on the cake — in the end, you still have to solve users' most genuine needs first.
Picking the right stack is just the icing on the cake — in the end, you still have to solve users' most genuine needs first.
Picking the right stack is just the icing on the cake — in the end, you still have to solve users' most genuine needs first.
I've noticed quite a few people are curious about how I use a Mac to develop Windows software, and what tech stack Windows software generally uses these days. I happen to have been working on something similar lately, so let me just chat about my thinking on multi-platform technology choices.
Anyone who has done frontend client work probably knows that client development has generally followed three paths in recent years.
The first and simplest is to write Web code directly and drop it into a browser to run. The amount of support and focus which other research groups were applying was great enough that even with a clever idea pursued by one person it was likely to arrive late and unconvincing because one person could not move fast enough and the baselines which one person could

sources.title: Xcode MCP 助力运行时二进制分析
sources.title_zh: Xcode MCP 助力运行时二进制分析
sources.title_original: Xcode MCP 助力运行时二进制分析
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以 EXC_BAD_ACCESS(subcode 0x1d)、栈中仅有 dispatch_source_set_timer + 36 等系统库的 Crash 为例，介绍如何通过 Xcode 的 mcpbridge 调用 LLDB，让 AI 在活动调试会话中下断点、读寄存器并批量验证，再由人收敛假设。

en.title: Xcode MCP enables runtime binary analysis
en.reason: An EXC_BAD_ACCESS crash with subcode 0x1d and a stack showing only dispatch_source_set_timer + 36 in libdispatch illustrates how Xcode's mcpbridge exposes LLDB to AI for setting breakpoints, reading registers and batch-verifying hypotheses, with engineers converging the results.

en.title: Firecracker VM Escape: PwnEscape Part Two

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Microsoft 不再续约 2023 年与 Oracle 的 AI 算力租赁协议，已逐步关停这批搭载较旧 Nvidia 芯片的服务器，同时重新评估超过 800 亿美元的外部云合同，并拒绝了扩大 Nscale 德州合作的选择权。

en.reason: Microsoft is not renewing its 2023 Oracle AI-compute rental deal, shutting servers with older Nvidia chips and re-evaluating over $80 billion in external cloud contracts while declining to expand its Nscale Texas partnership.
